title: Beta Mining Pluggable 5-Family Spacing Engine & Cost-Protected NET Dynamic TP
public_summary: Unlock Beta Mining from fixed 0.20% grid spacing by introducing 5 strictly causal SpacingProvider families paired with funding/fee-protected NET Dynamic TP under an unchanged 2.0 ETH max inventory cap.
inputs: 1000-day Binance Vision ETHUSDT USD-M 1m klines and historical 8h funding rates
Baseline 55 Beta Mining models at fixed 0.20% spacing (beta_mining/catalog.json)
outputs: Pluggable SpacingProvider (5 families) and DynamicTpConfig in python/alpha_mining/strategy/lgb154.py
Causal dynamic spacing & NET TP support plus consistency metrics in python/alpha_mining/research/backtest_lgb154.py
5 isolated Beta models (beta_056..beta_060, 1 per spacing family) evaluated over 1,000 days under max_position_quantity = 2.0 ETH
variables: dynamic_tp (net_profit_pct scaled with entry spacing and inventory relief above fee+funding floor)
constraints: max_position_quantity strictly locked at 2.0 ETH and initial_capital at 10000 USDT
strictly causal closed-bar evaluation (t_signal = t - 1 < t_execution)
strict isolation from live production bot.py
preserve all 55 existing baseline models and trial counters transparently
assumptions: strict_cross limit fills with 1-tick half-spread and 2 bps maker fee + historical 8h funding settlement
acceptance_criteria: All 5 spacing families pass zero-lookahead, max 2.0 ETH cap, and accounting conservation unit tests
All 5 pre-specified spacing models complete 1,000-day ETHUSDT 1m + 30-day crash stress evaluation and persist cleanly
cargo fmt/check/test/clippy --locked and python unittest discover exit 0

hypothesis.statement: Under an identical 2.0 ETH inventory cap and 10,000 USDT capital, replacing locked 0.20% spacing and flat PROFIT_PLUS_COMMISSION TP with volatility/inventory-adaptive spacing and cost+funding-protected NET Dynamic TP increases closed-cycle net win rate toward 100%, reduces max drawdown, and turns 1,000-day total MTM net PnL positive on the controlled baseline signal.
hypothesis.economic_rationale: Fixed 0.20% spacing exhausts the 200-bullet (2.0 ETH) inventory cap within the top ~33% of a drawdown and ignores negative 8h funding drift on multi-week holds, whereas volatility-scaled spacing rations inventory across tail regimes and NET TP enforces positive net expectancy per closed cycle.
alternative_explanations: Lower trade frequency alone reduces fees and funding exposure during trending drawdowns
Specific 2024-2026 ETH range endpoints favor wider static spacing regardless of dynamic adaptation
falsification_criteria: Dynamic spacing models still suffer negative 1,000-day MTM PnL and higher max drawdown than the fixed 0.20% baseline on the same signal, or violate the 2.0 ETH cap

cost_model_assumptions: 2 bps maker fee per leg, 1-tick half-spread, strict_cross fills, and real 8h historical Binance UM funding rates
leakage_controls: SpacingProvider.on_closed_bar(B_{t-1}) executes strictly prior to B_t order placement and fills
quant_checks.multiple_testing_plan: Pre-specify exactly 1 model per spacing family (5 total) prior to 1,000-day execution and increment catalog total_trials monotonically from 55 to 60
quant_checks.oos_validation_plan: Evaluate across full 1,000-day rolling window, 30-day worst crash window, and consecutive ISO-week positive cashflow hit-rate

authority.objective: Implement and evaluate 5 Beta Mining spacing families with NET Dynamic TP under 2.0 ETH cap
constraints: do not modify live bot.py or governance charters
